definitions.explanation: having to do something twice because it wasn't done properly the first time, resulting in unnecessary extra work

examples.japanese: {二度手間|にどでま}になった。
examples.english: I ended up having to do it twice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}る→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{二度手間|にどでま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you neglect to confirm, you'll end up doing it twice.

examples.japanese: {二度手間|にどでま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: To avoid doing it twice, do it carefully from the start.

notes:
{二度手間|にどでま} refers to the inefficiency of having to redo something.
